ITEM 1 | Pan-cooked fillet piece with orange-pink flesh and browned, slightly charred darker edges, dry-looking surface with small flecks of green herb and scattered grated pale granules on top; flakes with a moist interior, roughly 8 x 6 cm footprint covering about 10% of the plate, about 2 cm thick, sits alone on the upper right of the plate | 120

ITEM 2 | Pale yellow-green cubed fruit or vegetable, cut into roughly 2 x 2 x 2 cm irregular cubes with flat cut faces and slightly translucent edges, moist surface with no visible sauce, about 12 to 14 pieces clustered in the lower left of the plate covering about 25% of the plate | 150
